svg.title: Shot locations and supplied xG
svg.desc: Spain 2–1 Germany · 2024-07-05 · supplied StatsBomb xG Source: StatsBomb Open Data. Circle area encodes supplied xG with a minimum visible size; filled circles are goals. Attacking halves shown; all located shots retained. Both teams attack right in 120 × 80 provider units. Goal labels use elapsed match clock (MM:SS). Shootouts excluded.
